name: Isocarboxazid
metabolism: Evidence is from Isocarboxazid Tablets 10 mg (oral). Isocarboxazid is readily absorbed after oral administration, and most of the drug-related material is excreted as metabolites in the urine. The label gives no further detail on the enzymes, metabolites or elimination routes involved.
summary: Isocarboxazid is a non-selective, irreversible monoamine oxidase inhibitor of the hydrazine class, used primarily to treat treatment-resistant depression.
